document.about: Multi-Plastics 7500 PLA film product information sheet (2 pages, Word 2013). The letterhead, a revision year beside it, and an address footer are set identically on both pages.

notes: Furniture was read only from documents of three pages or more, so a two-page sheet kept its letterhead on both pages, and the second copy opened a level-1 section with everything after it nested under a duplicate of the title. A short document's running lines are now read from exact copies: the same text, size and weight at the same place on every page, or every page but one.
